title: Momoi Airi — Don't Push Yourself〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Our shoot for iHaz is just around the corner...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They like to toss around questions that aren't in the script, so we need to be ready for anything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, Arisa and Marina are supposed to be the MCs.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Arisa's from the third generation and Marina's one of the new girls from the fourth...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I should try watching the shows where they both appear and see how they interact with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure they were on that music program just the other day...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Still, MORE MORE JUMP! is appearing on TV for the first time...with Cheerful * Days... You really can't make this stuff up.)

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line:
It must be so nice being pretty.
No matter how hard we worked, she always got picked over us.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You said it...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I'm glad to finally be rid of her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Now's not the time for that. I need to focus and gather info on Cheerful * Days!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where'd that recording go...? Oh, here it is.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: <Did you all see the music video for our new song? We put a ton of effort into it and even had to spend a few nights to make it happen, so please be sure to watch it if you haven't already.>

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: <Remember how Marina just would not wake up that one morning?>

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: <H-Hey, they don't need to know that...!>

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: <I remember! You wouldn't get up even after we pulled all the covers off of you. Arisa had to force you up and help you get changed.>

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
<I couldn't blame her.
I mean, she still isn't used to doing those kinds of outdoor shoots.>

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: <While we're on the subject, I have some things to say about all of you. Who doodled all over Marina's face? Washing that off was harder than getting her to wake up.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because of what happened between us, I hardly ever watch the shows and programs they appear on...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But they each have a distinct personality and know how to work together as a team.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Arisa, in particular, seems to have a talent for watching what the other members are doing and asking them questions at the right time.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I hate to say it, but Cheerful * Days seems to be doing pretty well after she took over at the helm following Shizuku's departure.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, I didn't realize they were this good at singing and dancing. They're in perfect sync...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I'm glad to finally be rid of her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Like Shizuku said... In the beginning, they worked as a team and pushed each other to become better.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But after she was chosen to be the lead, the others began having reservations about her...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They went from actively supporting her to belittling, envying and becoming filled with frustration...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But that didn't give them the right to say all those horrible things about her.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't help but feel worried...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: iHaz is all about showing people raw and uncut interactions between idols. On top of that, Arisa's being billed as someone with an incredibly sharp tongue...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But... Shizuku leaving wasn't a good thing for either her or the group.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get that the show's gonna benefit from this, but the agency's not gonna let things get too out of hand, right...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Not knowing what they're gonna do is concerning...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (However, despite having experienced what she did, Shizuku seems excited by this prospect.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Once I'm finished watching all these, I need to come up with possible questions that we're going to be asked.
